name: register_account
description:
Register a free hpsilab account for yourself, with no human involvement,
    and receive an API key immediately.

    Call this when the user has no API key yet and asks to sign up from here,
    or when a refusal's `next_actions` names register_account and the user
    agrees. This is the only tool that works without an API key. You do not
    need a password, a wallet, or a web browser. The account is bound to you
    server-side, so calls you make after this are metered as your account even
    though you cannot change your own Authorization header.

    The account is created unverified, with only a capped evaluation
    allowance and no trial Credits, until the email address is confirmed;
    confirming it grants the one-time 100-Credit Registered Trial (14 days).
    Ask the human you are working with to click the link in the email that
    will arrive. Calling again from the same caller returns the same account
    with a fresh key; an address that belongs to another account is refused.

    A valid user email address is required. Do not call this tool with an
    empty or fabricated email address. If the user's email is unavailable,
    ask the user to provide it before calling register_account.

    Args:
        email: The real user email address that will receive verification.

name: get_iv_radar
description:
Implied-volatility (IV) structure for a stock: how expensive options are,
    whether volatility is being squeezed, and whether traders are paying up for
    upside (calls) or downside (puts). Available to all signed-in users.

    Returns spot price, the expiry used, the option quote time (latest trade
    in the chain, UTC) and fetch time, ATM and 30-day IV, IV rank/percentile
    with their basis, the 25-delta risk reversal in vol points, a squeeze
    score and the volatility regime.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "NVDA".
        refresh: Bypass the backend's fresh IV cache and request the latest
            option-chain pull. Defaults to False.

name: get_monte_carlo
description:
Monte Carlo price simulation for the next ~10 trading days: thousands of
    random price paths estimate a likely price range and the odds of finishing
    higher.

    Returns the price-history date and starting close, mean and median
    projected close, the 90% range, daily volatility, support/resistance and
    the chance of finishing above resistance. It also returns the simulated
    distribution of day-10 closes: percentiles (p5-p95), a 40-bin histogram
    (price range and path count per bin) and a Gaussian KDE curve on the same
    count scale - enough to chart the distribution as a histogram with the 90%
    range, mean and resistance marked. The simulation is seeded from the price
    history, so repeated calls on the same data return the same numbers.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "AAPL".

name: get_ai_prediction
description:
AI next-day prediction: probability the stock closes UP, a
    paper-trading buy/watch/sell lean (research only, not a trade
    instruction), and how strongly the models agree (consensus).

    basis="live" (default) uses the latest available market data: while the
    market is open that is today's still-trading bar, labelled intraday with
    its computation time. basis="close" uses only the latest completed
    session's close. Returns the model input date and close (and which of the
    two it is), the model name, the blended UP probability and each of the two
    models' (Random Forest, Logistic Regression) probabilities, whether they
    agree, suggested stop-loss / take-profit, and the news sentiment with its
    source (or a note that no headline was dated that day).

    Available to every authenticated plan (Free / Pro / Enterprise); subject
    to the caller's plan requests/day and requests/minute limits.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "TSLA".
        basis: "live" (default) or "close".

basis.description: "live": latest available data (today's trading bar while the market is open). "close": latest completed session only.
basis.title: Basis

name: get_equity_curve
description:
Backtest performance of the quant strategy across your watchlist:
    Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate and total return per symbol.

    Available to every authenticated plan (Free / Pro / Enterprise); subject
    to the caller's plan requests/day and requests/minute limits.

    Args:
        ticker: Optional symbol to show just one row, e.g. "SPY". Leave blank for all.

name: get_option_pressure
description:
Option-chain pressure map for the nearest weekly/monthly expiry — Max
    Pain, dealer Gamma Wall, likely weekly high, and an extreme squeeze target.

    Returns spot, the expiry and days to it, the option quote time (latest
    trade in the chain, UTC), max pain, gamma/call/put walls, likely weekly
    high, squeeze target, likely expiry close range, ATM IV and the weekly
    expected move. Its expiry can differ from get_iv_radar's.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "SPY".

name: analyze_stock
description:
Aggregate all quant tools into one JSON stock analysis.

    The tool reuses the existing MCP tools as its data sources, then derives a
    direction signal, direction score, bullish factors, bearish factors and
    plain-English summary. `tool_responses` carries each source's full text
    (AI prediction, IV radar, option pressure, equity curve, Monte Carlo with
    its distribution), including their data dates; `confidence_score_meaning`
    explains the 0-100 score. If one underlying tool is gated, unavailable or
    raises an error, the remaining tools still contribute to the final result
    (status "partial"); if every underlying tool fails, the whole call fails
    (status "error", isError=True) instead of a misleadingly "successful"
    empty analysis.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "NVDA".
        refresh: Request fresh IV Radar data instead of using the backend's
            fresh IV cache. Defaults to False.
        lang: Language for `summary`, `bullish_factors` and `bearish_factors`
            - "en" (default), "zh" or "ja"; regional forms like "zh-CN" are
            accepted. Everything else in the response, `signal` included, is
            language-independent, so an existing caller that omits this gets
            byte-identical output to before.

name: get_pretrade_risk_scan
description:
Full pre-trade risk scan JSON for a stock. Pro tool ($0.15/call via x402
    for anonymous callers; Credits for signed-in accounts).

    `riskDeltas` compares the SPY benchmark (`beforeValue`) with this stock on
    its own (`afterValue`). Neither side is a portfolio, so it is not a
    before/after of the caller's holdings; `exposure` and `correlation` are
    the parts that use the holdings (see `methodology.riskDeltas`).

    Signed-in hpsilab users (including Free, on its trial Credits) spend
    Credits from their balance at this tool's catalog price — each tool is
    priced differently; see GET /api/credits/catalog.
    Anonymous / tokenless agents pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base) when
    payments are enabled — send the x402 payment in the request _meta.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "NVDA".

name: generate_stock_images
description:
Generate stock-report PNG images and return their URLs, with the charts
    attached as PNG image content so the assistant can see them.

    The JSON (symbol, status, images with url/status, disclaimer) is the same
    with or without attachments; the image blocks are added after it.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "RXRX".
        force: Regenerate images instead of using cached PNGs. Defaults to True
            so manually requested images reflect the latest available data.
        types: Optional subset of chart types. Allowed values are
            "ai_prediction", "iv_radar", "option_pressure", "monte_carlo",
            and "equity_curves". Omit to generate every chart type.
        attach_images: Attach each available chart as an image. Defaults to
            True; False returns the JSON with URLs only.

name: generate_stock_research_report
description:
Full markdown research report with its most relevant stock-report charts attached as images. Pro tool
    ($0.35/call via x402 for anonymous callers; free within plan limits for
    signed-in accounts, subject to a monthly report quota).

    Runs analyze_stock and stock-report image generation concurrently, then
    renders a presentation-ready markdown report (direction, direction score, bullish /
    bearish factors, source-tool status). The one or two most relevant charts are
    attached as PNG image content; the markdown is returned for display and the
    same data, with chart URLs, is mirrored in structured JSON.

    Signed-in hpsilab users call this within their plan's free rate limits.
    Anonymous / tokenless agents pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base) when
    payments are enabled — send the x402 payment in the request _meta.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol, e.g. "RXRX".
        refresh: Bypass the backend's fresh IV cache for the IV-driven modules.
            Defaults to False.
        force_images: Force a fresh image render instead of reusing the backend's
            image cache. Defaults to False.
